sections.appearance: Maki has vibrant red hair and sky blue eyes. Her hair is styled into two buns, with fitting bangs and an ahoge. The buns in particular are holding back a considerable amount of hair, as her camp look shows her hair can reach close to her waist. Halo ==== Maki's halo has a red circle overline with the three smaller ones inside out and a gray inverted pyramid in the middle. Uniform ==== She has red, messy hair below shoulder-length with a cowlick and tied to buns on both side. She has bright blue eyes. She wears a navy blue hoodie with assortment accessory, a pink Veritas logo and a Millennium access badge on her left arm. Her standard uniform, including a black sweater, an untucked white shirt and blue tie underneath and a white skirt with black line on the rim. She has black socks and black and white sneakers with red decoration. Note that some areas around her clothes have paint splotches all over her. Gym: She wore a light blue uniform jacket, a dark blue T-shirt underneath, and shorts with two white stripes on the sides. Her shoes were the same as the original. Firearm ==== thumb|Auto Lacquer|150px She uses a two tone General Dynamics Lightweight Medium Machine Gun with a white lower receiver. The stock and handguard is painted with graffiti. The rest of the weapon is painted black. It is outfitted with a Trijicon ACOG Machine Gun Optic. The Millennium insignia is imprinted on the ammo box attached to the gun.

sections.personality: Maki is a mischievous girl who likes graffiti, and the creator of Veritas' emblem. She is an optimistic, go-with-the-motions type of person, and often gets into trouble with other club members. In addition to her actions as a graffiti artist, Maki also indulges in the trend of installing 'BOOM' on every electronic device she can, and is fond of video games and especially old-school shooters.
